role: Executes definition queries on the co-being semantic knowledge graph to answer 'what is X?' questions via typed semantic edge traversal and typicality scoring.
detail: Core module implementing proc:definition_query ProceduralTemplate. Main class DefinitionQueryExecutor answers definition questions by: (1) resolving query subject to a WordSenseNode, (2) traversing semantic edges (IS_A, HAS_PROPERTY, PART_OF, USED_FOR, etc.), (3) optionally following DENOTES bridges if no direct edges exist, (4) collecting IS_A ancestors and their properties up to depth=5, (5) scoring all facts using principled typicality algorithm (Rosch 1975) combining edge_type_weight (0.35), scope_context_factor (0.30), confidence (0.25), activation_boost (0.10 capped at 0.2), (6) applying optional spreading activation boosts, (7) truncating to token budget (600 tokens, ~30 tokens/fact), and (8) recording SemanticInferenceTrace for A.19 CANON compliance. Edge type weights: IS_A=0.40 (taxonomic), HAS_PROPERTY=0.25, PART_OF=0.20, USED_FOR/LOCATED_IN=0.15, causal/functional types=0.12, negations/analogical=0.10. Depth governance from EvolutionRule node rule:definition_depth_config; max_depth=5 is safe because working memory load is per-level not cumulative. Selective (not unconditional) DENOTES traversal to prevent fan-out doubling. Includes bootstrap function to create ProceduralTemplate and EvolutionRule graph nodes with idempotency.
gotchas: Selective DENOTES traversal (only when zero direct semantic edges on WordSenseNode) to prevent fan-out doubling — not unconditional. Token budget estimation is approximate (~30 tokens/fact); exact token counting deferred. Cross-domain fact tracking via denotes_traversed flag and cross_domain attribute on DefinitionFact. Ancestor property collection adjusts hop_depth to reflect distance from subject. Confidence_floor_hits counter present in result struct but not incremented in implementation (unused). Scope context factor capped at categorical_threshold (default 3) to prevent runaway scoring. activate_boost capped at 0.2 to prevent domination. No error on missing rule:definition_depth_config node — falls back to defaults gracefully.
